description: An emphasis and de-emphasis pair: a send filter that lifts the low end and cuts the high, and a return filter that takes that curve back out

params.text: Sets the low corner, three octaves below to four octaves above 50Hz
Sets how far the low end is lifted on the send, 0dB to 20dB, and cut by the same amount on the return
Sets the high corner, up to four octaves below 21.22kHz
Sets how far the high end is cut on the send, -20dB to 0dB, and lifted by the same amount on the return

inputs.text: Moves the low corner one octave per volt on top of the LOW knob
Moves the high corner one octave per volt on top of the HIGH knob
The signal into the send filter
The signal into the return filter

outputs.text: The IN signal with the low end lifted and the high end cut
The RTN signal with the send filter's curve taken back out

notes: the two halves are separate inside the module: IN reaches only SEND and RTN reaches only OUT, so the pair is meant to go either side of whatever is being driven
the two gain knobs come up at the RIAA settings of 20dB and -20dB; the maker warns in the manual that the return filter at those settings can put damaging levels into a tweeter
this module misbehaves on polyphonic cables: from the second channel on, both corner frequencies are pinned at half the sample rate
